label: sdc02_0150_dragonbb_01
text: Yo yo, Champ in the making.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0150_dragonbb_02
text: Sorry for the holdup. I’m back.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0150_dragonbb_03
text: So that’s two Elite Four members down already,\nhuh? You sure are crushing it.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0150_dragonbb_a_01
text: Crispin’s no pushover—he’s just super\nstraightforward.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0150_dragonbb_a_02
text: I think that’s kinda part of his charm, y’know?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0150_dragonbb_a_03
text: We used to all chow down on Crispin’s cooking\nafter club activities let out. Those were the days.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0150_dragonbb_a_04
text: Guess he’s been worrying about the way things\nare, too, in his own way.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0150_dragonbb_b_01
text: Amarys sure leaves an impression, huh?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0150_dragonbb_b_02
text: It’s wild seeing her and Carmine talk. You’d never\nguess it, but they click in a weird way. It’s pretty\r\nfunny to watch.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0150_dragonbb_b_03
text: The thing about Amarys is, as rigid as she looks,\nshe’s got a sensitive streak a mile wide.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0150_dragonbb_b_04
text: Remember that about her, OK? Even if it’s hard\nto tell from outside.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0150_dragonbb_c_01
text: Lacey’s all about cuteness—and that’s what helps\nher make her Pokémon stronger.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0150_dragonbb_c_02
text: She’s so into her team, training the little cuties\ndoesn’t even feel like work to her. Wild, right?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0150_dragonbb_c_03
text: I bet it’s the same for you, huh? You work so hard\nat it ’cause you like it![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0150_dragonbb_c_04
text: Unlike a certain someone who seems busy\nrunning himself and everyone around him into\r\nthe ground just to get a bit stronger.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0150_dragonbb_c_05
text: Y’know, Lacey’s polite to everyone else, but\nshe’s really blunt with me... I wonder why?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0150_dragonbb_d_01
text: Here’s your reward, like I said.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0150_dragonbb_d_02
text: Guess I should’ve cleaned it, but what’s a little\ndust between friends?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0150_brother_01
text: Seems like things are going well with the\nBB League...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0150_dragonbb_07
text: What’s up, mighty Champion? Scoping out the\ncompetition?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0150_brother_03
text: I was getting worried.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0150_brother_04
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]It’d be so disappointing if
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]
had
gotten
weaker.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0150_brother_05
text: But you seem as strong as ever, thankfully.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0150_brother_06
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)]...go all the way.
Don’t
go
losing.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0150_brother_07
text: I can’t show you how strong I’ve gotten if you\ndon’t even make it to me.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0150_dragonbb_08
text: Heh heh. Someone’s good and riled up.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0150_dragonbb_04
text: Anyway! You got places to be, right?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0150_dragonbb_05
text: I better not keep you. See ya.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0150_dragonbb_06
text: Good luck with the remaining Elite Two.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
